summary.text: Bill Wielechowski has served in the Alaska Senate for District K since 2007.

paragraphs.text: His legislative biography lists his occupation as attorney and his date of birth as December 7, 1967, with a J.D. from Seton Hall University School of Law (1989 to 1992) and a B.S. in business management and finance from Seton Hall (1985 to 1989).
Before the Senate it lists him as designated chair of the Alaska Workers' Compensation Board (1999 to 2004) and a member of the Anchorage Planning and Zoning Commission (2004 to 2006).
